draft_metadata.classification_reason: 原文核心工作是利用柱色谱与 HPLC 从 Talaromyces sp. ZZ939 大米发酵物中分离 37 个化合物，通过 HRESIMS、NMR、ECD 计算和 DP4+ NMR 计算解析 5 个新化合物的结构，并评价其对 MRSA、大肠杆菌、白色念珠菌的抗菌活性。该论文不涉及生物合成基因簇鉴定、酶催化机制或代谢工程/细胞工厂改造；目标产物为 azafenone（azaphilone 类）与 pyronaphthoquinone 类聚酮-萜混源或聚酮天然产物，仅做分离与结构表征。系统给出的三类框架（生物合成/酶工程/细胞工厂）均无法准确覆盖其真实学科方向，故 category=null，仅以最接近的跨类别综述条目作为提示。
source_gaps: 原文标注的 Fig. S1、S2 以及 Tables S1–S16 属于 Supplementary Data，本次未随 PDF 一并提供，因此无法对菌落形态、ITS 序列比对树、NMR 数据表内容进行逐项核对。
未提供 DP4+ 计算结果的具体化学位移对比表（仅给出概率分数）。
HRESIMS 谱图未单独展示，仅以列表方式给出精确 m/z。
Fig. 1 在第 2 页位于文末，结构密集，所估 bbox 覆盖整个结构区域及下方 caption；Fig. 2–4 共占第 3 页上中下三栏，Fig. 5 与 Fig. 6 共占第 4 页。

verified_claims.claim: 从Talaromyces sp. ZZ939大米培养基发酵物中共分离37个化合物（1–37），其中5个为新化合物：pinazaphilone C (4)、nemanecin F (7)、talarophilone acid A (8)、talaropyranone acid A (9) 和 talaromyesone A (10)
verified_claims.evidence: A total of thirty-seven compounds (1–37) were isolated from a culture of the flatfish-derived fungus Talaromyces sp. ZZ939 in rice medium… Pinazaphilone C (4), nemanecin F (7), talarophilone acid A (8), talaropyranone acid A (9), and talaromyesone A (10) were elucidated as five previously undescribed compounds.

verified_claims.claim: 化合物8对E. coli的MIC为37 µg/mL，化合物10对MRSA的MIC为25 µg/mL；阳性对照万古霉素和庆大霉素MIC均为0.25 µg/mL
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文PDF physical page 1 (Abstract) 及 physical page 5 (Results and discussion末段)
verified_claims.evidence: talarophilone acid A (8) had antibacterial activity against Gram-negative bacterium Escherichia coli with a MIC value of 37 μg/mL, while talaromyesone A (10) showed antibacterial activity against Gram-positive bacterium methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus with a MIC value of 25 μg/mL… Both control vancomycin (an antibiotic against MRSA) and gentamicin (an antibiotic against E. coli) showed activity with a MIC value of 0.25 μg/mL.

verified_claims.claim: 化合物4的DP4+概率分数：6S,7R模型13C NMR 97.85%、1H NMR 87.62%、合并99.69%；6R,7R模型分别为2.15%/12.38%/0.31%；最终指认6S,7R构型
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文PDF physical page 2, Results and discussion 一栏化合物4段落
verified_claims.evidence: the experimental NMR data of 4 were in good agreement with those of the model molecule 6S,7R-4 with DP4+ probability scores of 97.85% for 13C NMR data, 87.62% for 1H NMR data, and 99.69% for all NMR data… while the experimental NMR data of 4 were quite different those of the model molecule 6R,7R-4 with DP4+ probability scores of 2.15% for 13C NMR data, 12.38% for 1H NMR data, and 0.31% for all NMR data.

verified_claims.source_locator: 原文PDF physical page 2, Results and discussion 一栏化合物7段落
verified_claims.evidence: The HRESIMS of compound 7 showed ion peaks at m/z 255.1228 [M + H]+ (calcd. for C13H19O5+, 255.1232) and 277.1047 [M + Na]+ (calcd. for C13H18NaO5+, 277.1052), corresponding to a molecular formula C13H18O5… The NMR calculated data showed a 7S,8S,8aR,11S-configuration for 7… with DP4+ probability scores of 93.91% for 13C NMR data, 59.28% for 1H NMR data, and 95.73% for all NMR data.

verified_claims.claim: 化合物10分子式C17H18O8（m/z 723.1896 [2M+Na]+），含5个环的不饱和体系；绝对构型指认为2R,3S,4R,9R,11S,13R；为含oxacyclohexane与1,3-dioxane稠合环的pyronaphthoquinone类首例
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文PDF physical page 4, Results and discussion 一栏化合物10段落及 page 5
verified_claims.evidence: The molecular formula C17H18O8 of compound 10 was deduced from its HRESIMS ion peak at m/z 723.1896 [2 M + Na]+… the absolute configuration of 10 was assigned to be 2R,3S,4R,9R,11S,13R. Based on the foregoing evidences, compound 10 was elucidated as a previously unreported compound, named talaromyesone A… talaromyesone A (10) is the first example of this type of pyronaphthoquinone compound.

verified_claims.claim: 菌株ZZ939通过ITS rDNA序列比对鉴定为Talaromyces sp.（与10株Talaromyces模式株序列相似度>99.7%，453 bp片段），GenBank登录号PV872562
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文PDF physical page 2, Results and discussion 段落；physical page 5, 4.2节
verified_claims.evidence: The flatfish-derived fungus strain ZZ939… was assigned as Talaromyces sp. ZZ939 on the basis of its ITS rDNA sequence… that showed similarity (over 99.7% identity for a 453 bp stretch of sequence) to those of ten Talaromyces strains… The ITS rDNA sequence (deposited in the GenBank with accession no. PV872562).

verified_claims.claim: 规模化发酵条件：PDB种子液→40 g大米+60 mL 3.5%海水盐溶液，28 °C静置培养30天×300瓶；EtOAc提取得粗提物157.84 g
verified_claims.evidence: The seed broth of 5 mL was inoculated into rice medium (40 g rice with 60 mL 3.5% sea salt solution) in a 500 mL Erlenmeyer flask and then incubated for 30 days under static conditions at 28 ◦C. A total of 300 flasks were prepared for this study… The combined EtOAc extract solution was dried under reduced pressure to furnish a crude extract (157.84 g).
